title: Call button press
description: Topic borj/{ward}/{bed}/call. Published by the bedside node (or simulator) when a patient presses a button. A NON-AUTHORITATIVE signal: it never closes a task by itself. State transitions are owned by the server and published on call/state.

callId.description: Stable id for this call across repeated presses and state changes. A repeated press reuses the open callId and increments pressCount.

kind.description: assist = clinical help, routed to nurses. comfort = non-clinical (water, blanket), routed first to care assistants but visible to nurses.

deliveredLate.description: True when the node could not deliver in time (the patient saw not_sent) and this is the store-and-forward replay. `ts` is still the original press time.
